findings.name: Gameplay V3 retained Gameplay event accumulation
findings.summary: The committed V3 dispatch enters the authoritative boost-use, small/full-pad, and save accumulator; deterministic V1/V3 cases match those events while V3 touch remains zero.

findings.name: Explicit V3 reward branch and fail-closed unknown mode
findings.summary: V1/V2 retain their explicit shared historical branch, V3 has a distinct branch, and unsupported modes raise before ordinary stepping.

findings.name: Every V3 identity and dispatch site
findings.summary: The committed contract/hash lookup, constructor, setter, optional state/bridge, non-renumbering mode 5 kernel branch, validator, and checkpoint transition all dispatch V3 explicitly; strict V2-to-V3 loading rejects.

findings.name: Disposable rollout and shadow state
findings.summary: The validator contains no PPO/optimizer update call or checkpoint save, separates source and disposable sample counters, preserves model/optimizer/iteration/policy, and rehashes the source checkpoint after validation.

findings.name: V1/V2/V3 environment construction matrix
findings.summary: All three identities construct and step with (N,2,182) observations; V1/V2 have no V3 state or bridge binding and V3 has both.

findings.name: Array-derived V3 logical memory
findings.summary: The committed production inventory derives 316670188 logical bytes from 107 actual Warp arrays at 131072 worlds, allocates no calibration evidence buffers, and records allocator deltas separately.

findings.name: Inherited capture API remains untouched
findings.summary: The committed source diff contains no capture/invalidation changes; the audited training step still launches the V3 detector directly after physics and before reward accumulation/composition.
